options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: cluster_domain
options.description: The fully qualified domain name to be used to identify the new cluster. This cannot be changed later.

options.name: primary_node_ip_addresses
options.description: The static IP address(es) of this DNS server. Must be accessible by all other DNS servers to be added later as Secondary nodes. Accepts a list of IP addresses for nodes with multiple network interfaces. When multiple IPs are provided, they will be used for cluster communication.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.
